notes.title: Ruff Night At The Gallery Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello dog/art/ghost enthusiasts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39154509/a751eb273f8c847574822186d006f0c253035786.gif[/img]

If you're reading this, it means that Ruff Night At The Gallery is now available on Steam!  We originally created this game as part of the Fantastic Arcade "Shock and Aww" jam, but we're super excited to share it with a wider audience for free on Steam!

Before you check out the game, take a second to say hello to the dogs behind the dogs:
